name: resolve-capture-profile
description: Resolve the camera model + solver compatibility from the per-scene capture declaration {make, model, mode} via capture_profiles.json (STO-SCN-091). The model is a property of the camera/capture mode, decided from known metadata — NOT inferred from pixels (STO-SCN-096 #3, HUG-SCN-004). `mode` (fisheye|dewarped) is not in EXIF and must be declared per scene. The artifact identity is the hash of the declaration, so a given camera+mode resolves once and is reused.

make.note: camera make (capture declaration; EXIF corroboration only)

mode.note: fisheye | dewarped — NOT carried in EXIF; declared per scene
